## AsrTransport.subscribe property

Subscribe to events from the parent. The transport invokes the callback for every 'asr-event' that arrives, regardless of sessionId — the AsrSession filters by its own id. Returns unsubscribe.

**Signature:**

```typescript
subscribe: (callback: (event: AsrIncomingEvent) => void) => UnsubscribeFn;
```
